_note: Typeface sets for the journal article. A layout names its default set (layouts.json: typeface); a paper may choose another with :typeface: in its header. 'built' sets are open-license fonts kept in fonts/ (fonts/LICENSES.md). 'license-required' sets need font files a consumer licenses and installs in the directory IF_FONTS_LICENSED names, never in this design system; if they are missing the build uses the layout's default set and says so. Every set falls back to the house fonts and STIX Two Math for a character its own font lacks. scale is a size factor so a lookalike sets the same line length as the journal it is modeled on. frontiers-print FR-008.

house.summary: The house typeface: Source Serif 4 for text, Inter for headings, tables, captions, and boxes. Open licence; full glyph coverage.
house.modeled_on: No journal. Close to the width pattern of BMJ's Meta Serif and Nature's Harding Text (within 0.003 to 0.01 of the best open match in the measured comparison).
house.best_for: Everything by default; the safe choice.

spectral.summary: Spectral for text, Inter for the rest. A light, open, humanist text face.
spectral.modeled_on: NEJM's Quadraat, the closest open match measured (width-pattern residual 0.027, scale 1.00).
spectral.best_for: A page that should feel like NEJM or a similar humanist journal.

pt-serif.summary: PT Serif for text, Inter for the rest. A sturdy, large-x-height text face.
pt-serif.modeled_on: Nature's Harding Text and HBR's Guardian Text Egyptian and Le Monde Journal (best or second best open match; scale 1.07).
pt-serif.best_for: A page that should feel like Nature or HBR.

gelasio.summary: Gelasio for text, Inter for the rest. A Georgia-like, robust face.
gelasio.modeled_on: Minion Pro (PLOS ONE, Scientific Reports), Scala (The Lancet), and Meta Serif (BMJ): the closest open match for all three (scale 0.97).
gelasio.best_for: A page that should feel like PLOS ONE, Scientific Reports, The Lancet, or BMJ.

charis.summary: Charis SIL for text, Inter for the rest. A broad, sturdy face with the widest glyph coverage here.
charis.modeled_on: HBR's Le Monde Journal (closest, scale 1.03), BMJ's Meta Serif, and the Times of NAR.
charis.best_for: A page that should feel like HBR in its 2012 reprint, or a Times-like journal; and papers with many special characters.

lato.summary: Lato for text and for the rest: a sans-serif body, as JAMA sets.
lato.modeled_on: JAMA's Guardian Sans body, the closest open match measured by a wide margin (residual 0.016, scale 0.98).
lato.best_for: A JAMA-style page. Pair with a sidebar layout.

quadraat-scala.summary: Quadraat for text, Scala Sans for the rest.
quadraat-scala.best_for: A page that matches the journal's own type. Needs licensed font files.
quadraat-scala.note: Install licensed copies in `fonts-licensed/` (a directory the consumer provides beside `fonts/`, never committed)  with the file names given here (edit them to match your files). Without them the build uses the layout's own set and says so.
